IC1: Phase I: Patients must have histologically [AND] confirmed R/R  NHL [OR] or HL (defined [AND] by WHO criteria). Patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) [OR] and small lymphocytic lymphoma (SLL) are eligible. In addition, patients with NHL [NOT] other than diffuse large B cell lymphomas (DLBCL) [AND] must have received at least 2 prior therapies. Patients with DLBCL [OR] and HL [AND] will be eligible if there is [NOT] no available standard therapy.
IC2: Phase II: Patients must have histologically confirmed R/R NHL (as defined by WHO criteria). Patients with NHL [AND] [NOT] other than diffuse large B cell lymphomas (DLBCL) [AND] must have received at least 2 prior therapies. Patients with DLBCL [AND] will be eligible if there is [NOT] no available standard therapy.
IC3: Must have received front line chemotherapy. No upper limit for the number of prior therapies
IC4: Evaluable Disease in the Phase I [OR], and measurable disease in the Phase II
IC7: Patients must have adequate organ and marrow function
IC9: Ability to understand and the willingness to sign a written informed consent document
